name: ruff-format2
question: Format the given new files with the project's ruff (the extra arguments: the paths), so that the checked commit's ruff format passes.
choices: A new unit file (rule (c)): units/ruff-format.json named the ruff binary by a relative path, which the job's CreateProcessW did not find (its attempt is abandoned in the journal). This one runs the .venv's ruff as a module. It rewrites only the files named. A tree unit: the same paths and code state is the same unit.
